name: intro
label: Body
default: Enter the trade you need and your ZIP code. Matched workers show their skills, experience level and distance up front, so you're reviewing people, not resumes.

name: visual_label
label: Description of the illustration
default: Example: a search for Journeyman Electrician near 46204 Indianapolis finds 4 matching workers, including a private profile with a 96% profile score.
help_text: Read out by screen readers in place of the illustration, including the card module below it. Update it when you change the example.

name: copy_offset
label: Copy offset (px)
help_text: Desktop only. How far the copy block sits below the top of the search bar, as drawn in Figma: Company 140, Job Seeker 112. The copy may run down beside the card below.
